title: Belrose Layaway and Hold Agreements Till Reference: Payment Frequency, Scheduled Amounts, Statements and Early Payoff
content:
# Till reference — scheduled payments and statements under Belrose Layaway and Hold Agreements

The plan an agreement was written on fixes how often a scheduled payment falls due, the two figures the scheduled payment is read from, how often a statement goes out, and whether paying up early earns a discount. Belrose Layaway and Hold Agreements sets them as follows.

| Plan | Payment frequency | Minimum scheduled payment (USD) | Scheduled payment as a share of the balance at opening | Statement frequency | Early payoff allowed | Early payoff discount on the remaining balance |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 30-Day Hold Agreement | monthly | 25.00 | 100 percent | on request | yes | 0 percent |
| 90-Day Layaway | biweekly | 35.00 | 12.5 percent | monthly | yes | 0 percent |
| 6-Month Layaway | monthly | 50.00 | 8.34 percent | monthly | yes | 1 percent |
| 12-Month Bridal Layaway | monthly | 75.00 | 4.17 percent | monthly | yes | 2 percent |
| Special Order Layaway | monthly | 100.00 | 12.5 percent | monthly | yes | 0 percent |
| Gift Registry Layaway | monthly | 50.00 | 6.25 percent | monthly | yes | 1 percent |

## Column by column

- **Payment frequency**: how often a scheduled payment falls due. The 90-Day Layaway falls due every two weeks; every other plan falls due monthly.
- **Minimum scheduled payment**: the smallest scheduled payment the agreement will ask for.
- **Scheduled payment as a share of the balance at opening**: the share of the balance at opening that a scheduled payment asks for. On the 30-Day Hold Agreement the share is the whole balance, so the plan asks for everything in one scheduled payment.
- **Statement frequency**: how often a statement is sent. The 30-Day Hold Agreement issues a statement only on request; every other plan issues one monthly.
- **Early payoff**: every plan allows the agreement to be paid up before the term ends. The 6-Month Layaway and the Gift Registry Layaway take 1 percent off the remaining balance for doing so, the 12-Month Bridal Layaway takes 2 percent off, and the 30-Day Hold Agreement, the 90-Day Layaway and the Special Order Layaway take nothing off.
